findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qmax_get_quote, qmax_get_tape · Private data: qmax_list_assets, qmax_get_quote, qmax_build_plan, qmax_get_health, qmax_swap_quote, qmax_get_wallet_ledger, qmax_get_liquidity_positions, qmax_get_liquidity_pool, qmax_get_candles · Public sink: qmax_build_plan, qmax_get_liquidity_positions · Destructive: qmax_check_arbitrage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qmax_get_quote, qmax_get_tape · Private data: qmax_list_assets, qmax_get_quote, qmax_build_plan, qmax_get_health, qmax_swap_quote, qmax_get_wallet_ledger, qmax_get_liquidity_positions, qmax_get_liquidity_pool, qmax_get_candles · Public sink: qmax_build_plan, qmax_get_liquidity_positions · Destructive: qmax_check_arbitrage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
